- Initial release of yaps-background-removal skill.
- Removes backgrounds from JPG, PNG, WebP, or BMP images using Yaps.
- Supports transparent output by default, with options for solid backgrounds or sticker outlines.
- Requires Yaps version 2.3.124 or newer and user authorization for model installation.
- Enforces careful verification of output quality and strict boundaries for image handling.
